findings.text: Baseline's status key and its List read one store, each control's live status; publishing results moves them with Overview and Controls.
Posture's band counts open operational issues and risks from the live Findings and Risks registers; a published result or a new risk moves it.
One setup checklist, each step read from its record: Overview's card says 2 of 7 and opens the checklist; Getting started folds into Overview.
Every snapshot is taken one way, inherited controls included: rows, preview and page agree, today's is the live count, and Programs' trend reads the rows.
SCTM sheet tabs name the subsets they hold: Requirements behind 92 controls, Evidence they cite, Operational issues and assessment findings.
findings.why: The sheets come from a frozen snapshot; rebuilding them from full registers or splitting Findings needs the workbook's builder.

findings.text: Mapping a requirement moves Baseline, Cyber resiliency's SA-24 line, Posture's objectives and Requirements, which all read the chain's one control store.
Accepting evidence moves Overview's tile, the assessor's request tracker, My work's assessor item and the Event log, which records each review.
A person's records are counted from the registers' owner fields; the heading's total is the sum of the tiles, open tasks included.
Map a requirement offers only register requirements; approving the Requirement drafter's run adds REQ-641–643 to Requirements and its chain view at once.
One people-and-roles record for WS-X90, gate deciders included, read by People, Overview's Team, ITCSC §11, person pages' SSP access and Permissions.
A control's preview and page name the assessment finding behind its status and its campaign; AU-7's component inheritance shows under Responsibility.
WS-X90's tailoring is F-16 SPO Tailoring on Baseline and ITCSC §6; Cyber T&E cites that tailoring, since WS-X90 holds no customer requirements document.
Findings states its open-issue count once: the cards' and All's repeats are gone.
findings.why: Authorization's ATO date and SSE's due date are lane G's pages; the facts they need are published.

findings.text: Counts agree or say what they count: Enterprise techniques on Cyber T&E, the STIG run's checklists, CN-109000's 43 of 44, the chain view's requirements.
The program menu's Activity is WS-X90's event log; Settings' Event log spans every program with a program filter and a Program column.

extra.text: Increment 2 is counted control by control: AU-6(3) and AU-12(1) move from Partially satisfied to Satisfied, so Partially satisfied reads 37, not v2's 39.
Traceability is Requirements' Chain tab; every traceability address opens it, and its tiles say they count requirements.
Role holders v2 had no record of (Marcus Ryde, Lena Marsh, R. Feldman) open their own preview instead of R. Calloway's.
